_comment: Per-SCENE establishing art for the Baldur's Gate areas the game actually visits, so each location renders ITS OWN scene instead of the repeated Lower-City cityscape (EPIC D). Scope is the colon form scene:<slug> where <slug> EXACTLY matches the engine area id minus its loc- prefix (areas/*.json id loc-counting-house -> scene:counting-house). The viewer's _scope_key strips both the leading 'location'/'scene' AND 'loc' prefix tokens, so the UI scope location:loc-counting-house normalizes to 'counting-house' and matches the ingested dir scene_counting-house. Regions (loc-lower-city, loc-upper-city, ...) and a handful of areas (elfsong-tavern, sorcerous-sundries, wyrms-rock) already have scene art — covered elsewhere; not repeated here. Three areas are intentionally OMITTED: heapside-warrens (no Heapside-specific establishing image on bg3.wiki — its page only carries Basilisk Gate art + book icons), little-calimshan and siltwharf-steps (no bg3.wiki page exists — ClawDnD-invented neighborhoods). They keep the graceful placeholder. patriars-walk and rivington-crossroads use direct File: titles to pick a DISTINCT Upper-City / Outer-City shot (Szarr's Palace, Circus of the Last Days) rather than re-using the upper-city / outer-city region images. Official wiki images are © Larian / dual-licensed bg3.wiki content -> land ONLY in gitignored content/worlds/_private/<world>/images/ (owner local play, never committed; scripts/license_check.py stays green). Re-run: python3 tools/ingest/wiki_images.py tools/ingest/manifest_images_scenes.json
